topic: Expansion into US and Brazil markets
summary_markdown: A general update was provided regarding AllUnite's growth. Positive feedback from sales meetings was noted, particularly concerning the ongoing work on the Brazil case, which is viewed as a global showcase. The company highlighted recent positive meetings with Walldecaux (their new data director) and the CEO of Intersection in the US. The goal is to establish a presence in the US market during Q1 or Q2 next year.
